packer_binary.description: Optional path to a Packer binary to use instead of the embedded one. Conflicts with `packer_binary_url`.

packer_binary_checksum.description: Optional SHA-256 checksum (hex, optionally prefixed with `sha256:`) used to verify the file downloaded from `packer_binary_url`. The checksum is computed over the downloaded artifact itself (e.g. the zip archive, not the binary inside it). Requires `packer_binary_url`.

packer_binary_url.description: Optional http(s) URL to download a Packer-compatible binary from, used instead of the embedded one. The URL may serve a raw executable or a zip archive containing one (a file named `packer`/`packer.exe`, or a single-file archive). Downloads are cached locally and reused; changing the URL or checksum triggers a fresh download. Conflicts with `packer_binary`. This provider is an independent project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by HashiCorp. You are responsible for choosing a trustworthy URL and for complying with the license of the downloaded binary. Use `packer_binary_checksum` to verify the download.

additional_params.description: Additional parameters to pass to Packer. Consult Packer documentation for details. Example: `additional_params = ["-parallel-builds=1"]`

build_uuid.description: UUID that is updated whenever the build has finished. This allows detecting changes.

directory.description: Working directory to run Packer inside. Default is cwd.

environment.description: Environment variables to pass to Packer

file.description: Packer file to use for building

ignore_environment.description: Prevents passing all environment variables of the provider through to Packer

manifest.description: Packer manifest content decoded as a dynamic value. Access fields directly in Terraform.

manifest_path.description: Path to the Packer manifest JSON to read after build. If set, a manifest must be written to that path. If unset, the provider passes a temporary path via environment variable TPP_MANIFEST_PATH; if Packer does not create it, the manifest remains null.

name.description: Name of this build. This value is not passed to Packer.

packer_version.description: Detected Packer version used for this resource. Changing this forces replacement.

sensitive_variables.description: Sensitive variables to pass to Packer (does the same as variables, but makes sure Terraform knows these values are sensitive). Can contain following types: bool, number, string, list(string), set(string).

triggers.description: Values that, when changed, trigger an update of this resource

variables.description: Variables to pass to Packer. Must be map or object. Can contain following types: bool, number, string, list(string), set(string).

directory.description: Directory to run packer in. Defaults to cwd.

file.description: Packer file to use for building

file_dependencies.description: Files that should be depended on so that the resource is updated when these files change

files_hash.description: Hash of the files provided. Used for updates.

block.description: Specify files to detect changes. By default, the current directory will be used.
